description: This file contains functions for pretty-printing and formatting Python source code, including line wrapping, splitting lines, and adding parentheses to make code more readable. It appears to be part of the 'astor' library for Python AST manipulation, specifically for source code decompilation and formatting.

methods.name: pretty_source
methods.description: Prettifies the source code by splitting lines and rejoining them.

methods.name: split_lines
methods.description: Splits input source into lines, fixing lines that are too long.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the length of groups of strings.

methods.name: wrap_line
methods.description: Wraps a long line into multiple lines with proper indentation.

methods.name: split_group
methods.description: Splits a group of tokens into two subgroups for line wrapping.

methods.name: delimiter_groups
methods.description: Splits a line into alternating groups based on delimiters like parentheses and brackets.

methods.name: add_parens
methods.description: Attempts to add parentheses around a line to make it splittable.

methods.name: get_assign_groups
methods.description: Splits a line into groups based on assignment operators.
